title: Revision-Based Learning from Interactive Experience and Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.26636v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Code generation models are increasingly used to produce interactive artifacts, such as websites and user interfaces. Many properties that determine whether these interfaces are useful only become apparent through realistic interaction, making them difficult to incorporate into model training. In this paper, we introduce RELIEF (REvision-based Learning from Interactive Experience and Feedback), a method for improving code generation models using feedback on their generated interfaces. RELIEF uses a coding agent to revise these interfaces, then incorporates the improvements into their original generation traces to produce supervision for fine-tuning. To evaluate RELIEF, we collected a dataset of 200 synthetically generated websites paired with 355 interaction recordings and accompanying feedback from 24 users. We used critiques derived from code inspection, automated interaction, explicit human feedback, and human interaction recording

translated_title: 基于修订的交互式体验与反馈学习
translated_abstract: 代码生成模型越来越多地被用于生成交互式制品，例如网站和用户界面。决定这些界面是否有用的许多特性只有通过真实的交互才能显现出来，这使得它们难以被纳入模型训练。在本文中，我们提出了RELIEF（REvision-based Learning from Interactive Experience and Feedback，基于交互式体验与反馈的修订学习），这是一种利用对生成界面的反馈来改进代码生成模型的方法。RELIEF使用编码智能体来修订这些界面，然后将改进内容融入原始生成轨迹中，从而产生用于微调的监督信号。为了评估RELIEF，我们收集了一个数据集，其中包含200个合成生成的网站，以及355个交互记录和来自24位用户的伴随反馈。我们使用了源自代码检查、自动化交互、明确人类反馈以及人类交互记录的批评意见……
tldr: 提出RELIEF方法，通过编码智能体根据人类交互反馈修订生成的交互式界面，并将改进内容融入原始生成轨迹作为微调监督信号，从而改进代码生成模型。
en_tdlr: RELIEF improves code generation models by using coding agents to revise generated interactive interfaces based on human interaction feedback and incorporating the improvements into original generation traces as fine-tuning supervision.
